node.title: H3 quotient Galois-orbit scalar decomposition
node.statement: For n=2^s, the (n-1)(n-2) ordered nonidentity quotient lifts form exactly 3(n-s-1) odd-Galois orbits; there are 3(2^j-1) orbits of degree 2^j for 1<=j<=s-1. Their orbit polynomials factor the monic quotient polynomial over Z[1/2], and the odd radical support of the cutoff-35 scalar annihilator is exactly the union of the orbitwise scalar-annihilator supports. At n=8192 this gives 24,534 independently checkable blocks of degree at most 4,096. Total degree is unchanged, and no algorithm, factorization, valuation, moment bound, or C36 close is claimed.
